rules.when: Any UI build or visible UI change (layout, styling, wording on a page).
rules.why: Captain 2026-11-03: every UI build runs on Opus 5.5 high and loads premium-ui-polish, never Sonnet.

rules.when: The hardest work: open-ended architecture or design spanning several repos or subsystems, a security audit of a trust boundary or secrets path, a root-cause hunt with no reliable repro, a protocol, wire-contract, transport, or data-migration change whose mistakes are costly to undo, or any task where many interacting parts must be held in mind at once and a wrong call is expensive.
rules.why: Captain 2026-10-02: effort scales with task difficulty, from medium up to xhigh; xhigh is the top of the range for the hardest, highest-blast-radius work.

rules.when: Work that needs real reasoning but is bounded: an investigation with a partial lead, a design choice inside one subsystem, a non-trivial feature or bug fix touching several modules, a risky refactor, debugging with a repro, or a review whose findings need judgment.
rules.why: Captain 2026-10-02: effort scales with task difficulty; high is the middle band.

rules.when: Easy, well-understood implementation with a clear spec: a small bug fix or feature in one module, a version bump or release, a mechanical edit, a docs or board text change, a node install or hardware window that follows a known runbook, or collecting data with a given method.
rules.why: Captain 2026-10-25: use Sonnet 5.5 for easy implementation tasks to save tokens; Opus 5.5 stays for work that needs real reasoning (high) and the hardest work (xhigh).
